purpose: Audit current project artifacts and propose one reconciled doctrine mutation for later explicit seal-of-truth promotion.

canonical_anchor.head_message: doctrine: seal M1 signed secure WebView socket contract

crowned.notes: Defines typed Kotlin bridge, headless socket broker, strict TLS/SSH/OpenVPN boundaries, outbound-only typed antenna proposals, release locks, and physical-device proof requirements.
Defines Project Hydra hierarchy and GitHub versus owner-only Drive authority split.

canonical_active.notes: luhmos-main is branch authority; standalone Android base launch requires no Termux, Secure Folder, VNC, root, or external localhost daemon.
Reference-not-copy, no destructive reroll, capture first, crown last, no secrets, no duplicate runtime.

debug_evidence.notes: Proves widget/APK debug build and one-tap Termux/Ollama handoff. It is non-promotable and used a transitional pinned Android build bridge.

source_candidates.notes: Modular Sprite Cockpit source gate passed, but candidate is not merged, built, signed, device-validated, or crowned.

local_ai_evidence.name: Mini Luna Direct Green lane
local_ai_evidence.notes: Direct Ollama terminal is preferred when its warm-load smoke is GREEN; historical AMBER timeout must not be silently treated as execution proof.

local_ai_evidence.name: Three Lane Source Pass
local_ai_evidence.notes: AI logic, Ollama, and dictation lanes were packaged with donor-ingestion and compile/push/publish locks false.

legacy_compatibility.notes: Still names GitHub branch main and remote-first auto order openai -> huggingface -> deterministic_mock. It must not outrank current luhmos-main/local-first doctrine.
Retained for compatibility until current Project Hydra runtime absorbs required behavior.

test_harness.notes: Chrome Dev and Chrome Canary may validate behavior and compatibility only. No Chrome donor code or Chrome runtime dependency may enter future release APKs.

audit_findings.title: Current crown and branch authority are unambiguous
audit_findings.finding: luhmos-main plus the M1 signed secure WebView/socket seal are the current software/source-contract parent authority.

audit_findings.title: Legacy branch metadata drift
audit_findings.finding: lumh-os/kai9000/project.manifest.json still points its GitHub remote role at main instead of luhmos-main.
audit_findings.proposed_resolution: Treat that field as superseded compatibility metadata and patch it in a later authorized cleanup.

audit_findings.title: Legacy remote-first AI routing conflicts with local-first doctrine
audit_findings.finding: Legacy auto routing begins with OpenAI/Hugging Face while newer doctrine and local runtime evidence prefer local Ollama first.
audit_findings.proposed_resolution: Local deterministic policy and Ollama first; remote providers are explicit typed escalation only.

audit_findings.title: Widget model target versus Mini-Luna model target
audit_findings.finding: The compiled debug widget targets qwen2.5:3b, while the newer Mini-Luna lane keeps qwen3:0.6b.
audit_findings.proposed_resolution: Do not rewrite historical build evidence. Make qwen3:0.6b the proposed local-chat default only after a GREEN warm-load smoke; otherwise retain the last tested working model until evidence changes.

audit_findings.title: Direct Termux RUN_COMMAND is debug-only under M1
audit_findings.finding: The older widget proves direct foreground Termux launch, but M1 requires future release authority to cross a typed allowlisted Kotlin bridge/socket broker and forbids arbitrary shell authority.
audit_findings.proposed_resolution: Grandfather direct RUN_COMMAND as debug evidence only. Future release widget actions must use the typed bounded bridge/broker contract or open a user-visible app surface without arbitrary shell capability.

audit_findings.title: Standalone APK and local Ollama can coexist
audit_findings.finding: The base LuHm OS APK must launch standalone without Termux or an external daemon; local Ollama/Termux remains an optional user-invoked companion and laboratory lane.
audit_findings.proposed_resolution: Optional companion functionality must never become a base-launch dependency.

audit_findings.title: Historical debug APK used a transitional Android build bridge
audit_findings.finding: The debug widget artifact used a pinned vue-headless-cms build-time bridge.
audit_findings.proposed_resolution: Keep the artifact as evidence only. New canonical release APKs must be KAI-owned and donor-purged.

audit_findings.title: M1 runtime is not yet runtime-green
audit_findings.finding: Typed Kotlin bridge, socket broker, rejection tests, persistent signer, signed APK, physical Samsung proof, and live WSS reconnect/reboot evidence remain required.
audit_findings.proposed_resolution: Do not infer runtime/release GREEN from source-contract GREEN.

audit_findings.title: Modular Sprite Cockpit remains a source candidate
audit_findings.finding: Its source gate is GREEN, but it is not merged/canonical and has no candidate APK/signing/device proof.
audit_findings.proposed_resolution: Keep it in proposal/candidate status until separately authorized promotion.

resume_phrase: continue KAI 9000 from proposed M1 local AI widget doctrine reconciliation
signature_meaning: AI-authored proposal and audit only; not Professor approval and not a crowned seal.
